partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: GOF correction localized through anatomy-cell composition
results.hypothesis: A drug that suppresses a GOF driver is more credible when Bgee expresses the driver in a cell that SemMedDB places within an anatomy affected by the disease.
results.body: Drug decreases a G2P GOF driver; driver is expressed in a cell explicitly part of a disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule adds a graph-native cell-to-anatomy composition bridge to signed disease correction, but the partonomy and disease-location edges are literature-mined.
results.trapi_notes: The positive six-edge motif is TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, exact variant/effect qualifiers, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(cell:Cell)
MATCH (anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)-[part:HAS_PART]->(cell)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(part.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(binding.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: GOF activation localized through anatomy-cell composition control
results.hypothesis: Increasing the same anatomy-localized GOF driver is a matched worsening control for R406.
results.body: R406 anatomy-cell architecture with increased GOF-driver activity
results.mechanism_rationale: The localization evidence is retained while the intervention reinforces the GOF disease mechanism.

results.mechanism_rationale: The intervention direction is restorative and anatomically localized, but the graph does not establish residual responsive protein.
